statement: A restarted-node recovery timeout preserves direct-target startup handoff evidence (startup branch, infrastructure-join completion, canonical-authority consumption/state/source, and transaction-recovery state/readiness/outcome) into terminalRecoveryReadiness and deterministically attributes the earliest incomplete transition without treating bootstrap or control-plane reachability as recovery readiness.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Classify the direct target in causal order: incomplete infrastructure join precedes missing canonical-authority consumption, which precedes transaction recovery not started/pending/failed. Bootstrap health, admin health, and control-plane recovery are observations only and cannot skip an earlier incomplete transition.

The failure bundle and restart-recovery stability gate must retain the structured direct-target fields; human-readable timeout text alone is not closure. Preserve null/unknown honestly when older evidence lacks a field.

A deterministic fixture matching the retained N=15 restart timeout (bootstrap reachable, admin refused, control-plane recovery ready, canonical authority false, transaction recovery not_started) must remain blocked and must not be misclassified as recovered.

Do not change startup runtime behavior, recovery activation, bootstrap routing, load, readiness predicates, or timeout budgets. This Quest closes the missing discriminator only; a later product Quest owns whichever lifecycle transition the evidence selects.

The current TLA+ readiness-handoff model assumes eventual pre-handoff serviceability and the current Alloy model checks static owner cardinality, so neither distinguishes the retained trace while infrastructureJoinComplete is absent. Run the existing model-contract gate for adjacency, but extend a model only if this Quest changes lifecycle semantics beyond evidence projection.
